.smartMapping

Source: R/utilities-mapping.R
dot-smartMapping.Rd

Check data size and variable names, Get the mapping if variable names correspond to usual aesthetic or mapping names. Else return NULL for the mapping property.

If data has only one variable, it will be mapped as x. If data has only 2 variables, they will be respectively mapped as x and y.

Recognized names for the mapping are x, y, ymin, ymax, lower, middle, upper, color, shape, linetype, size and fill

Usage

.smartMapping(data)

Arguments

data

data.frame on which the smart mapping is used

Value

A list of usual mappings that can be guessed from data

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Get variable names x and y directly from data
data <- data.frame(x = c(1, 2, 3), y = c(6, 5, 4), z = c(7, 8, 9))
mapping <- .smartMapping(data)

# If data has aesthetic propoerties
data <- data.frame(x = c(1, 2, 3), y = c(6, 5, 4), color = c("blue", "red", "blue"))
mapping <- .smartMapping(data)
} # }
